About the author

At age 63, David has worked for some 44 years in the communications sector as a journalist, broadcaster, author, and international public relations consultant and business communications strategist. As a journalist, foreign correspondent and stringer from 1965 until 1980, David worked for media such as the BBC, Sveriges Radio, ABC (US), ABC (Australia), Metro Media News, The Guardian, International Herald Tribune, Chicago Daily News, Toronto Globe and Mail, Yorkshire Post, Birmingham Evening Mail and others. In 1979, David launched Sweden's first English-language business magazine, Marketplace Sweden. I also worked on developing international press materials for the Swedish Challenge for the Americas Cup, the Pelle Pettersson-designed 'Sverige'.
